name: papermint
description: High-performance Node.js & TypeScript bindings for papermint thermal printing library

scripts.build: cargo build --release && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const d=path.resolve('../../target/release'); const m={'linux':['libpapermint_node.so','papermint.linux-x64-gnu.node'],'win32':['papermint_node.dll','papermint.win32-x64-msvc.node'],'darwin':['libpapermint_node.dylib','papermint.darwin-' + process.arch + '.node']}[process.platform]; if(m&&fs.existsSync(path.join(d,m[0]))) fs.copyFileSync(path.join(d,m[0]), m[1]);"
